commits.author: marco.spasiano
commits.message:
feat: allow call winners to upload supplementary documents

Introduce a new `jconon_call_aspect_winner` aspect that lets admins
enable an attachment upload window for winning candidates, and refactor
shared CMIS property constants used across scoring logic.

- Add jconon_call_aspect_winner CMIS model with `active` flag and
  `elenco_file` (allowed attachment types) properties, plus a
  dedicated `attachment` aspect for winner-submitted files.
- Register JCONON_CALL_ASPECT_WINNER in JCONONPolicyType and expose
  its properties via JCONONPropertyIds.
- CallService: when the winner aspect's `active` flag changes, grant
  or revoke Contributor ACL on confirmed winning applications so
  candidates can/can't upload attachments during the open window.
- CallService: restrict which call properties can be edited after
  publication via a whitelist (changedKeysCall), including the new
  winner properties and punteggio fields.
- Add bulkInfo form definition (P_jconon_call_aspect_winner_aspect.xml)
  for managing the aspect from the call admin UI.
- Frontend (my-applications, call.js, call-labels.js, cnr.call.js):
  add a "winner" action button that opens an attachment modal for
  candidates whose application outcome is 'V' (winner) when the
  aspect is active; wire up the elenco_file selector lists.
- Add IT/EN labels for the new aspect fields, the winner action, and
  a new file-size-exceeded message.
- Refactor PrintService: remove duplicated punteggio property
  constants in favor of centralized JCONONPropertyIds entries; replace
  lambdas with method references where applicable.
- Utility: add valuesEqual/numbersEqual helpers for type-safe
  comparison of CMIS property values (numbers, Calendar, etc.) used
  by the new change-detection logic.
- Minor cleanups: extract header logo into logo.ftl, restrict
  OpenApiSecurityConfig to the "keycloak" profile, bump
  cool.shared.version to 4.0.68.

commits.author: marco.spasiano

feat: add destination structure and venue in English to call exports

- Register 'i18nDisplay' Handlebars helper to dynamically switch between Italian and English text based on the active locale.
- Update XML configuration for bulkInfo ('F_jconon_call_folder.xml') to include 'sede_en' and 'struttura_destinataria_en' column fields.
- Integrate the 'i18nDisplay' helper into the main results Handlebars template to display localized venue and destination structure information.
